title: Keep rotary angles in float32 after model dtype conversion
author: sylvesterkaczmarek

data.description: Keeps rotary inverse-frequency buffers and position construction in float32 after model dtype conversion to avoid repeated positions and angular rounding error in bfloat16.

Uses nonpersistent integer frequency indices that follow device moves but survive model dtype conversion, while rebuilding rotary caches in float32 and preserving cache reuse, output dtype, and checkpoint keys.

novel_contributions: Preserve rotary angle precision by rebuilding caches in float32 after dtype conversion
Use nonpersistent integer frequency indices that survive dtype conversion but move with device changes
Avoid repeated rotary positions and cosine/sine table collapse in bfloat16
Maintain cache reuse, requested output dtype, and checkpoint compatibility
